Celebrate Victory day with Uber
2018-12-11T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/celebrate-victory-day-uber-1671745

To have hassle-free and safe commuting during the biggest festive day of the country, Uber can be the friend you need in many different ways! One could enjoy the day with family and friends with Uber X and Uber Premier, to be dropped off without having to worry about where to park your vehicle on a day when everyone would be out celebrating, therefore, there would be more traffic and less spaces to park in the city.

As it's a national holiday, one could be a little more humane to offer your personal chauffer a day off too with using an Uber!

Uber Hire comes in play if you have plans to go places, and if you are planning to visit and pay respect at National Martyrs' Memorial in Savar, you could now use Uber Intercity. With just tapping a button on your App, your Uber driver would be at your doorstep to take you to your destination.

As 16 December falls on a Sunday, making it a 3-day long holiday, Uber Intercity could take you to beautiful resorts in Gazipur, Narayanganj, Savar to have the time of your life!

Download the Uber app for iOS or Android and create an Uber account:

Android users can download UBER app from following link:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ubercab

IOS users can download UBER app from following link:

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/uber/id368677368?mt=8
